About Salt of the Earth Cleaning Co.

A Richardson, Texas house cleaning company built on a simple promise: do honest work, pay attention to the details, and treat every home like it matters. Because it does.

Get My Instant QuoteCall (469) 210-8005

Founded on a principle of excellence

Salt of the Earth Cleaning Co. was founded in Richardson in 2025 by Brian Fuentes on one simple principle: excellence, in every home, every time.

Look around the cleaning business and you'll see a lot of the same thing: rushed visits, checklists treated as suggestions, and corners that get skipped when no one is looking. We wanted to do things differently. So we built a company where the standard isn't "good enough." It's done right.

That means wiping the baseboards and the light switches, not just the counters. It means asking questions up front, so every request is handled exactly the way you want it. And it means being honest about how long a thorough clean takes, instead of racing to the next house. That commitment to excellence shapes everything we do, from who we bring onto the team to how we leave your kitchen.

What "salt of the earth" means to us

People who are "salt of the earth" are the ones you can count on: honest, hard-working, the real thing. That's the standard we hold our team to.

  • Honesty. Upfront pricing you can see before you book, and straight answers to your questions.
  • Dependability. We show up when we say we will, and we try to send the same trusted cleaner every visit.
  • Care. We treat your home, your belongings and your pets with respect. If anything ever comes up, we'll tell you right away.
  • Detail. Our clients notice the fans, the baseboards and the windows. That's on purpose.

People you can trust in your home

Every member of our team goes through a background check before they clean a single home. We're selective about who joins us, because the trust you place in us is something we take seriously. Our English-speaking cleaners make it easy to explain exactly how you like things done. We use professional-grade, eco-conscious products, and we're happy to use yours if you prefer. And we're proudly pet-friendly: lots of the homes we clean come with a dog or a cat.
